scientific_scope_status: The acquired historical proof PDF Theorem14.2 describes a raw degree<=4 Boolean-ANF compiler at n=4a,a>=5. It acquires a field, quartic etale algebra, affine coordinates and phase from the actual input, reconstructs trace-hidden quartic square terms using a Hessian Pfaffian identity, then verifies every original coefficient before exact counting.
